explanation: This test only verifies that the FX rate is locked at the initiation of the top-up (fx_lock). It does not verify that the destination wallet is credited before the funding source is debited (credit_before_debit), nor does it test the rollback behavior on provider callback timeout (timeout_rollback), nor the dual approval requirement for top-ups above SGD 10,000 (dual_approval).
missingAssertions: Verify that the destination wallet is credited before the funding source is debited
Verify that if the payment provider's callback times out after 5 seconds, the transaction is rolled back and neither side is affected
Verify that top-ups above SGD 10,000 require approval from a second business owner before settling
hypothesizedBugThisWouldMiss: A bug where the funding source is debited before the destination wallet is credited would not be caught. Also, a bug where the transaction is not rolled back after a timeout would not be detected. Finally, a bug where top-ups above SGD 10,000 do not require second-owner approval would be missed.

suggestedReplacement.description: Verify full top-up transaction flow including FX rate lock, credit before debit, timeout rollback, and dual approval for large amounts
steps: Initiate top-up of USD 100 and record FX rate at initiation
Verify FX rate used matches recorded FX rate
Verify destination wallet is credited before funding source is debited
Simulate payment provider callback timeout after 5 seconds and verify transaction rollback with no changes to wallet or funding source
Verify that the transaction requires approval from a second business owner before settlement
suggestedReplacement.expectedResult: FX rate is locked at initiation; destination wallet is credited before funding source is debited; transaction rolls back on provider callback timeout with no changes; top-ups above SGD 10,000 require second-owner approval before settlement
